title: Telemetry Portrait: Route & Model Compact Panels
creator: Aisha Moreno
description: Design a compact, vertically oriented ‘Telemetry Portrait’ card that can be embedded in per-route and per-model overview pages. The goal is a densified, scannable summary of latency (P50/P90/P99), throughput (RPS), token metrics (avg tokens/request, tokens/sec), and cost-per-1k-tokens that fits in a 360x520 px panel and works in single-column mobile and multi-column desktop layouts. The card should support an expanded microtrace view (waterfall + sparkline), a quick compare toggle against a baseline model or previous deployment, and annotation markers for recent rollouts or incidents.
acceptance_criteria: Compact card mounts on both /route/:id and /model/:id overview pages without layout overflow
Shows latency P50/P90/P99, throughput RPS, avg tokens/request, tokens/sec, and estimated cost/1k in a single glance
Chart interactions: hover tooltips, click-to-open microtrace, and compare toggle that overlays baseline series
Spec provided for data aggregation (windowing/rollup), color palette, and threshold semantics for alerts
Prototype reviewed and approved by PM and Eng for feasibility (no blocked data dependencies)
design_notes: Primary view: three stacked tiles — headliner metrics row (compact numerics), midrow trend sparkline (latency & throughput dual-axis), footer microtrace thumbnail
Numerics prefer monospace for token counts; use differential color for regressions (amber/rose) and green for improvements
Latency sparkline uses rolling P90 as primary, small P50 ribbon, and faint P99 ticks — keeps noise down while surfacing outliers
Throughput uses area underlaid with latency line to visually show load vs latency correlation
Compare toggle overlays previous deployment or pinned model variant; overlay opacity and dashed line style for baseline
When expanded, microtrace shows swimlane waterfall with per-token timing aggregated into 10–50ms buckets depending on resolution
Card should support two density modes: compact (default) and detailed (expanded within a modal). Compact loses fine-grained P99 details but preserves the P99 marker and spike indicator
Accessibility: ensure color contrast meets AA for numeric values and provide alternative text for microtrace thumbnail
Performance note: downsample data server-side for >24h ranges to avoid client memory spikes; spec below
Sizing: target grid units consistent with Console design system: width 360px (1-column) and 720px wide variant for embedded double-width
chart_specs: Headliner numerics: three columns — Latency (P50/P90/P99) | Throughput (RPS / 1m avg) | Token stats (avg tokens/request, tokens/sec, est cost/1k)
Latency sparkline: timeseries of P90 over selected window; resolution configurable (1m, 5m, 1h); y-axis linear with automatic bounds padded by 10%
Throughput overlay: secondary y-axis on right; area chart with soft alpha (0.18) and primary color palette index 2
P50 ribbon: thin band shaded behind the P90 line at 60% opacity to communicate central tendency
P99 ticks: plotted as discrete markers (diamond) with tooltip containing sample count and max token latency
Microtrace thumbnail: stacked horizontal bars representing phases (tokenization, KV lookup, attention, decoding); color-coded by phase; hover expands per-phase timing
Aggregation rules: <=6h window raw 10s rollups; 6h-72h 1m rollups; 72h-30d 5m rollups; >30d 1h rollups
Sampling: when downsampling, use max-aggregation for latency series to preserve spikes; avg-aggregation for throughput and tokens
Tooltips: include timestamp, metric value, sample_count, model_variant, deployment_id, and route_id
Thresholds & badges: configurable threshold tiers (warning, critical) displayed as small left-aligned dot with hover explanation; thresholds come from route config or org defaults
Export: allow CSV export for displayed aggregated series and PNG snapshot of expanded microtrace
Interactions: click a microtrace marker -> open Trace Viewer (route to ENG trace endpoint)
Color palette: use Console palette tokens: --color-uber-1 (primary), --color-amber-5 (warning), --color-rose-6 (critical), --color-muted-2 (background sparkline), --color-green-4 (improvement)
Responsive rules: below 420px switch to stacked single-column metrics and hide throughput area (accessible in expanded modal)
Compare overlay spec: baseline dashed line (#000000, 30% opacity) with annotation showing baseline id and time range
reviews: 2025-01-20 PM review (Zoe Patel): Likes compact numerics, requests adding cost/1k visibility and a small CTA to open billing breakdown
2025-01-24 Eng feasibility (Rajiv Kumar): Feasible but flagged data cardinality for microtrace; suggests server-side rollup and new endpoint for trace thumbnails
2025-02-03 Accessibility review (Marta Ruiz): Requested higher contrast for P99 marker and keyboard focus state for compare toggle
2025-02-10 Design crit (Team): Agreed to reduce microtrace detail in compact mode and move full waterfall into an expand modal
decisions: Use P90 as primary sparkline metric for compact view to reduce noise and surface actionable regressions
Preserve P99 as discrete spike markers to keep the compact card lightweight
Server-side rollups and max-aggregation for latency to avoid client-side gaps
Default compare target = previous successful deployment for that route; user can pin alternative model variant
Microtrace expanded in modal; compact shows thumbnail with spike heatmap only

Update Figma with final tokens and keyboard states, then request final sign-off from PM and Accessibility
